name: Impact analysis before changing a table, field, or script
intent: Community MCP servers already grew table-config / field-reference / script-reference tools for a reason. This is that idea as a first-class skill.

subject.description: Table name, field name, or Script Include name to analyze impact for.

procedure: Input: table, field, or Script Include name.
Search Business Rules, Script Includes, Flows, UI Policies, ACLs, Transform Maps that reference it.
Return a count + top 20 references with type and name. Do not fetch every script body.

prompts: What references the incident.state field before I change its choices?
Which Business Rules and Flows call ScriptInclude MyUtils?
Impact analysis on table cmdb_ci: who touches it before I add a column?
